questions.q: The Indian state with the lowest sex ratio is:
questions.solution: Using the 2011 Census state figures relevant to this paper, Haryana has the lowest sex ratio among the listed states.

questions.q: When did China invade Tibet?
questions.solution: Chinese forces entered Tibet in 1950. The question refers to the invasion before the 1951 agreement.

questions.q: Which of the following organisms is considered a bioindicator of water pollution ?
questions.solution: Frogs are sensitive to environmental contamination, including polluted water, and can act as bioindicators.

questions.q: Density of a population (D) is:
questions.solution: Population density is number of individuals divided by the space or area occupied.

questions.q: How does the integration of biometric technology enhance India's internal security framework?
options: By improving identification and verification processes
By eliminating the need for human security personnel altogether
By reducing paperwork and streamlining administrative processes for citizens
By providing real-time location tracking enhancing overall surveillance
questions.solution: Biometrics verify identity using physical or behavioural characteristics, improving identification processes.

questions.q: Who led the Bardoli Satyagraha in 1928?
questions.solution: Vallabhbhai Patel led the Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928.

questions.q: The "Loktak" lake is located in which state of India?
questions.solution: Loktak Lake is in Manipur and is known for its floating phumdis.

questions.q: The words "Unity and Integrity of the Nation" in the Preamble aim to promote which fundamental principle ?
questions.solution: The Preamble links fraternity with the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the nation.

questions.q: Which article of the UDHR (Universal Declaration of Human Rights) guarantees the right to seek asylum from persecution ?
questions.solution: Article 14 of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights addresses seeking and enjoying asylum from persecution.

questions.q: The full form of NPA is .
questions.solution: NPA stands for non-performing assets, referring to lending assets that fail the prescribed repayment-performance criteria.

questions.q: 'India Wins Freedom' is the autobiography of whom?
questions.solution: India Wins Freedom is the autobiographical account of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.

questions.q: The World Conference on Human Rights in 1993 adopted the .
questions.solution: The 1993 World Conference on Human Rights adopted the Vienna Declaration and Programme of Action.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty ?
options: Ban all nuclear explosions for both civilian and military purposes
Promote the peaceful use of nuclear energy
questions.solution: The CTBT aims to prohibit all nuclear test explosions, including those claimed to have peaceful purposes.

questions.q: Arjuna Award is conferred for achievements in the field of:
questions.solution: The Arjuna Award recognises achievements in sports.

questions.q: ___________is a software program that filters all the data coming through the Internet.
questions.solution: A firewall controls incoming and outgoing network traffic under security rules.

questions.q: What is the term for the strategic use of social media platforms to communicate with an audience?
questions.solution: Using social media to reach an audience for promotional objectives is social media marketing.

questions.q: What is the capital of Bhutan ?
questions.solution: Thimphu is Bhutan’s capital.

questions.q: Which is the longest River bridge in India?
questions.solution: For the river-bridge category in this paper, Bhupen Hazarika Setu, also called Dhola–Sadiya Bridge, is the intended answer.

questions.q: When did the Government present the Kisan Credit Card Scheme ?
questions.solution: The Kisan Credit Card scheme was introduced in August 1998.

questions.q: How does the partnership between India and Vietnam change their regional security dynamics?
options: By increasing defence cooperation and maritime security
questions.solution: The India–Vietnam partnership includes defence cooperation and maritime security collaboration.

questions.q: 14 September is celebrated as:
questions.solution: National Hindi Diwas is observed on 14 September.

questions.q: The Bharatmala Pariyojana is related to :
questions.solution: Bharatmala Pariyojana is a road infrastructure programme.

questions.q: What is the name given to NASA's manned landing mission to the Moon which is likely to happen by 2024-25?
questions.solution: The programme named in the historical question is Artemis. The date quoted is an old planning expectation, not a current launch commitment.

questions.q: The International Thermonuclear Experimental Reactor (ITER) project aims to demonstrate the feasibility of:
options: Fusion energy as a large-scale and carbon-free source
questions.solution: ITER investigates whether nuclear fusion can provide a practical large-scale energy source.

questions.q: Who is the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha as of June 2024 ?
questions.solution: Rahul Gandhi became Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha in June 2024, the date specified.

questions.q: Who is the author of the book "Tughluq Nama"?
questions.solution: Amir Khusrau wrote Tughluq Nama.

questions.q: What does the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) do ?
options: Provides financial aid for fossil fuel projects worldwide
Develops nuclear energy programmes for developing countries
IRENA focuses on advancing nuclear power
Promotes the use of renewable energy
questions.solution: IRENA promotes the adoption and sustainable use of renewable energy.

questions.q: Which of the following type of tax is submitted in Indian GST?
questions.solution: Service tax was subsumed into GST. Income tax, wealth tax and property tax are different tax categories.

questions.q: Who among the following first propounded the idea of Basic Education?
questions.solution: Mahatma Gandhi proposed the Basic Education or Nai Talim approach.

questions.q: Which of the following festival is known as the festival of lights in India?
questions.solution: Diwali is widely called the festival of lights.
